messages:
deploy-bot: Build pipeline started for release v1.28.0 (commit abc1234) — environment: staging. Steps: lint -> unit -> integration -> package. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3130001234

sara: :eyes: lint step failed immediately, see summary below. Landing PRs were merged in last 10m.

deploy-bot: lint failed (eslint): 1 error reported. first failing file: src/runtime/cache.js: 'no-restricted-syntax' triggered. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3130001234/logs/lint

matt: I can take a quick look. That rule is from eslint@8.4 bump in dev-deps from yesterday. Could be new rule enforcement.

kevin: quick triage — if it's from eslint ruleset change, we should either pin eslint to 7.x for this RC or add an inline disable if it's a known false-positive. Pinning is fastest for RC.

olivia: pinning dev-deps in the release branch ok for staging only? We need to avoid surprising prod.

sara: We also see a single flaky unit test: tests/test_inference.py::test_kv_cache (timeout) but it didn't block yet because lint failed first.

matt: Proposed plan: 1) rerun lint alone to rule out transient; 2) if still fails, pin eslint to 7.32 in release branch and rerun full build; 3) open follow-up PR to fix lint rule properly. Thoughts?

jen: +1 to rerun. If rerun still fails, pin for RC. We can do a canary patch later.

sara: Running targeted rerun: `/ci rerun 3130001234 --stage=lint`

deploy-bot: Rerun triggered by sara. Lint stage queued.

deploy-bot: Rerun finished — lint still failing (same error).

kevin: Ok pin time. I'll push a small change to release/v1.28.x: set eslint@7.32 in package.json and lockfile. Patch will be marked as release-only.

matt: Thx. After pin and lockfile commit, can someone trigger full pipeline?

olivia: @deploy-bot please kick full build when kevin's commit is pushed: `/ci start 3130001234 --full`

deploy-bot: Noted. Waiting for new commit.

kevin: Pushed commit def5678 to release/v1.28.x with eslint pinned and lockfile updated. PR: https://git.redwood.example/release/4523

deploy-bot: New commit def5678 detected on release/v1.28.x. Starting full build for pipeline 3130001234.

deploy-bot: Lint succeeded. Unit tests started.

sara: Keeping an eye on that flaky kv_cache test; I'll rerun unit stage if it flakes.

deploy-bot: Unit tests finished — 1 flaky failure retried and passed. Integration stage queued.

matt: Thanks everyone. After merge we should add a short note in release notes: "Temporarily pin eslint in release branch to avoid CI break; follow-up PR will re-enable rule with fix."

jen: I'll add the note to the release checklist and mark the issue for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
